newsitem.title: USA: United machinists approve wage agreement.
newsitem.headline: United machinists approve wage agreement.

text.p: The International Association of Machinists said Thursday its members ratified a mid-contract wage agreement reached earlier this month with United Airlines, the chief operating subsidiary of UAL Corp.
The union said more than 80 percent of the eligible employees who voted approved the contract, which calls for two wage increases of five percent in July of 1997 and 1998.
Under the agreement, wages will be restored by the year 2000 to levels in effect prior to July of 1994.
In early January, the union, which represents more than 12,000 of United's employee-owners, rejected a proposal that would have increased pay by 10 percent over four years.
A United spokesman told Reuters the carrier's union pilots have yet to vote on a similar tentative wage increase agreement also reached earlier this month.
UAL shares were off 1-1/4 Thursday at 67.
